claim_text: A Ticketmaster outage stopped fans at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans from loading mobile tickets on Friday night, Nov 20
summary: Fans at the first night of the Usher and Chris Brown show could not load Ticketmaster tickets. The organizer, Live Nation New Orleans, and the venue manager, ASM Global, both said Ticketmaster was having an outage.
detail: Live Nation New Orleans posted that Ticketmaster was 'currently experiencing a service outage' and told fans to go to the box office. Fans who had saved tickets to their phone wallets got in without trouble. Doors were set for 6 PM Central (7 PM ET).
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Four outlets with different owners report the organizer's and the venue manager's own statements, and WDSU had crews on site.

claim_text: Long lines formed outside the Superdome and the concert started late
summary: WWL and WBRZ report that thousands of fans waited in long lines, some for hours, and that the venue manager said the show was delayed. By about 9 PM Central (10 PM ET) the Superdome posted video of Usher and Chris Brown on stage.
detail: WWL also reports fans pushing at doors and some fans leaving because the app still would not load. It gives no start time for the show, and the 10 PM ET time here is converted from its 'around 9 p.m.' (Central).
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The delay comes from the venue manager's remarks to WWL; WBRZ's account builds on WWL's reporting, so we treat it as one line of reporting.

claim_text: Fans who had saved their tickets to a phone wallet were not affected
summary: ASM Global's media relations manager said fans who had downloaded their tickets or added them to a digital wallet would not be affected. Live Nation New Orleans and the Superdome said the same.
detail: This is advice from the venue side, repeated by several outlets. It describes the Superdome; we did not find the same guidance from Ticketmaster for other venues.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The statement is attributed to the venue manager and the organizer in four outlets.

claim_text: Downdetector logged nearly 500 problem reports, mostly about the app, starting around 8:33 PM ET
summary: Hindustan Times reports that Downdetector showed almost 500 Ticketmaster problem reports on Friday night, most of them about the app, with complaints starting at 8:33 PM ET.
detail: These are user-submitted reports, not a count of affected customers. We did not read the Downdetector page itself. A Spanish-language outlet we could not open reported a US peak above 600, so the peak varies by when it was counted.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet relays Downdetector's figures; Downdetector's own page was not read.

claim_text: Reports came from several US states and from New Zealand, not just New Orleans
summary: WDSU says online reports and viewers described the website and app being down in New Orleans, Minnesota, California, Washington, Miami and New Zealand.
detail: WDSU does not give counts. Hindustan Times and others call the outage 'nationwide', and ASM Global's spokesperson called it nationwide.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: WDSU lists the places; WWL quotes the venue manager calling it nationwide.

claim_text: Service was mostly back by about 9:30 PM Central (10:30 PM ET), though some fans still had trouble
summary: Around 9:30 PM Central, Superdome officials said the problems were mostly resolved, though the app 'might have had intermittent stops.' WDSU and FOX 8 also say service came back.
detail: WDSU's 9:35 PM Central update said fans were being scanned in. Some fans told WWL the app still did not work for them after that. No source gives an official all-clear time. WWL's article also puts the show on stage at about 9 PM Central, before the 9:30 PM resolution remark, so these times are approximate.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Three outlets say service came back; the timing rests on venue officials, not Ticketmaster.

claim_text: Ticketmaster's X accounts said it was 'not seeing any reported issues' with its site, and also that the issue was 'on our radar'
summary: Outlets quote a Ticketmaster X reply, 'We're not seeing any reported issues with our site at this time', and another post saying 'this is on our radar, and our team is actively looking into it.'
detail: Hindustan Times quotes the first, NOLA.com the second, and WDSU quotes the Fan Support account sending fans with a problem tonight to the box office. We did not read the posts on X; we rely on how the outlets quote them. The sources do not say which post came first, so we do not say Ticketmaster changed its position. Ticketmaster has not published a status page notice or a statement on the cause that we found.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Three outlets quote the posts, but they are social posts we could not open ourselves.

claim_text: Ticketmaster support told a fan in line that it was 'experiencing issues with our tool'
summary: WWL and WBRZ report that a fan waiting at the Superdome who contacted Ticketmaster support received this reply: 'We are experiencing issues with our tool, and we are unable to view your order. We are actively working on this.'
detail: This is one fan's account of a support message, passed on by WWL. It was not a public statement by Ticketmaster and says nothing about the cause.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The quote is a single fan's account carried by one outlet's reporting.

claim_text: On Thursday, Nov 19, a Ticketmaster disruption delayed entry at the South Dakota state volleyball tournament
summary: TicketNews, citing local news, reports entry lines wrapped around the arena in Sioux Falls on Thursday evening. Reports surged after about 4:30 PM Central (5:30 PM ET); most services were back before 6 PM Central (7 PM ET).
detail: TicketNews cites Dakota News Now; the arena is the Denny Sanford PREMIER Center. TicketNews says local reporting did not establish whether people could not retrieve tickets or whether venue scanners were affected. We did not read the Dakota News Now report.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One trade outlet, relaying local reporting we did not read.

claim_text: Thursday's complaints came from the US, UK, Canada and Ireland
summary: TicketNews says elevated reports on Thursday came from the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Ireland. IsItDownRightNow's page shows reports at outage level in five countries, with a peak of 544 reports in 15 minutes.
detail: IsItDownRightNow counts outage level from 4:14 PM ET Thursday to about 10:11 PM ET, a longer span than TicketNews's 'restored shortly before 6 PM Central'. The two may be measuring different things. The counts are user reports, not verified outages.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: An outlet and an automated tracker agree on the countries; the counts are user-submitted.

claim_text: Neither Ticketmaster, Live Nation nor any outlet we read says the outage was, or was not, a cyberattack
summary: We found no claim of responsibility, no report of an attack and no statement from Ticketmaster or Live Nation on the cause. We also found no statement ruling an attack out.
detail: The outlets that asked Ticketmaster for the cause (WWL, WDSU) reported no reply as of their updates. The White House's Nov 18 statement on recent outages came before these events and does not name Ticketmaster.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the nine sources we read gives a cause or addresses an attack.

claim_text: The cause of the Nov 20 and Nov 19 disruptions
summary: Ticketmaster has not said what caused either disruption. Its support reply to one fan mentions 'issues with our tool' and nothing more.
detail: No vendor, cloud provider or software update has been named in any source we read.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Outlets report that Ticketmaster had not explained the cause.

claim_text: A comment on a Downdetector page said 'somebody or something is probing the security boundaries of these companies' IT infrastructure'
summary: Hindustan Times quotes an anonymous comment on Downdetector's Ticketmaster page suggesting someone is probing large companies' systems. It gives no evidence.
detail: We treat it as an unsourced rumor. It names no incident, shows nothing and no outlet or official has backed it. We do not name the commenter.
label: Rumor
why_it_supports: The comment is anonymous and has no evidence; Hindustan Times only quotes it.

claim_text: The Ticketmaster outage is linked to Thursday's disruption or to this month's other outages
summary: No source links the Nov 20 outage to the Nov 19 disruption, to Ticketmaster's October transfer problems, or to the FAA, Microsoft 365, bank or other outages of recent weeks.
detail: Hindustan Times mentions the string of outages but offers no link. TicketNews notes the November 12-13 Microsoft outage affected ticket access through email but treats it as separate. The same company is involved on both nights, which is why we ask.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: No source ties the events together or rules it out for Ticketmaster.

claim_text: The White House said on Nov 18 it sees no indication of a cyberattack behind recent tech outages; it did not name Ticketmaster
summary: A Nov 18 White House release quotes the DNI and the National Security Adviser seeing no indication of a coordinated cyberattack behind recent tech outages and no evidence the incidents are related.
detail: The release came two days before the Ticketmaster outage and does not mention Ticketmaster, so it is context, not a finding about Ticketmaster. It confirms what officials said, not an independent finding.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The release is the primary document and carries the quotes.
